signal: short each preannounced monthly day-16 vesting window; no price/size/return filter
source_limitation: published monthly schedule, not verification of each wallet transfer or selling; exact intraday unlock time not claimed
window_reason: first full calendar year after 2024 cliff through last complete entry-to-next-entry cycle; no claim of unseen holdout
known_contamination: discovery snippets included 2024 ARB declines; published research and prior BTC experiments already seen; retrospective only
cost_limitation: reference assumptions, not historical/account fees or empirically executable quotes; no actual lot/margin certification

funding.cash: signed quantity times actual rate and settlement mark high-low bounds
funding.completeness: under-limit bounded API responses plus gap/boundary checks; does not independently certify provider archive

risk_exit: definite breach REJECT, uncertain intrabar/funding crossing INSUFFICIENT; stop before further path/statistics, no fabricated stop fill
control: frictionless short each entry-to-next-entry cycle at same candidate quantity times 8 days/cycle duration; real funding; matches coin-time only, not beta/volatility; not deployable alternative

statistics.unit: nonoverlapping monthly complete cycle PnL per initial capital
statistics.multiplicity: two-candidate Bonferroni one-sided 97.5% bounds; both net and timing lower must pass both block lengths
statistics.reject: definite risk breach or both net upper bounds <= 0
statistics.worth: both net and candidate-minus-control lower > 0 for both blocks
